synthetic-lending.name: synthetic-lending
synthetic-lending.title: Synthetic lending data with planted group bias
synthetic-lending.source: Generated by xaidash.data.generate_lending (SYNTHETIC, not real people)
synthetic-lending.description: Synthetic loan-repayment data. Group B has a planted label penalty and planted measurement noise (see generate_lending). Used to validate the fairness audit against known ground truth. Findings on this data are NOT real-world findings.
synthetic-lending.sensitive_use: audit only; never a model input
limitations: Entirely synthetic: the bias is planted by construction.
Gaussian-like features and a logistic outcome are far simpler than real credit data.
area_risk_index is a deliberate proxy for group membership.

adult.name: adult
adult.title: Adult / Census Income (1994)
adult.source: OpenML dataset 'adult' (data id 1590), originally UCI Machine Learning Repository, fetched with scikit-learn fetch_openml
adult.version: OpenML version 2; raw table sha256 d273d956c28eba72
adult.licence: Public (UCI repository, CC BY 4.0 for the Adult dataset)
adult.description: 1994 US census extract. Task: predict income above 50K. Nine of the fourteen columns are used, with categorical columns reduced to binary indicators.
adult.sensitive_use: audit only; never a model input
limitations: Collected in 1994; reflects historical labour-market inequality, so subgroup gaps are largely a property of the data, not only of the model.
Sex is recorded as a binary attribute; no other identities are represented.
Proxies for sex (for example marital status and hours per week) remain in the features.
Not a decision-ready dataset: a benchmark for demonstration only.

breast-cancer.name: breast-cancer
breast-cancer.title: Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer
breast-cancer.source: scikit-learn bundled copy of the UCI WDBC dataset (sklearn.datasets.load_breast_cancer)
breast-cancer.description: 569 fine-needle-aspirate records, 30 highly correlated numeric features.
breast-cancer.sensitive_use: not applicable: no sensitive attribute is recorded
limitations: 569 rows only; test sets are small and intervals are wide.
Features are strongly collinear, which stresses attribution methods.
A teaching benchmark, not a clinical tool.
